summary: Iteration 11 - Server decomposition and Lightspeed X-Series integration testing complete. Verified the major refactor from 3300-line monolith server.py to 11 modular route files. All 21 backend tests passed. All frontend UI features verified working.
passed_tests: GET /api/health returns healthy status with PostgreSQL database
POST /api/auth/login with admin/admin returns JWT token
POST /api/auth/login with wrong credentials returns 401
GET /api/users without auth returns 401
GET /api/users returns list with admin user
GET /api/settings returns valid JSON with lightspeed_store_id and lightspeed_secret_token
GET /api/settings masks lightspeed_secret_token as ***
PUT /api/settings updates lightspeed_store_id and lightspeed_secret_token correctly
PUT /api/settings with masked token '***' does NOT overwrite actual token
GET /api/settings removes old fields (lightspeed_api_key, lightspeed_api_secret, lightspeed_cluster)
GET /api/dashboard/stats returns product and supplier counts
GET /api/products returns paginated product list
GET /api/suppliers returns supplier list
POST /api/suppliers creates a new supplier
GET /api/sync/logs returns sync log list
GET /api/sync/log/{log_id} returns 404 for non-existent log
GET /api/category-mappings returns mapping list
POST /api/settings/lightspeed/test with no credentials returns mock mode message
GET /api/preprocessing/products returns paginated list
GET /api/preprocessing/summary returns summary stats
LightspeedService uses correct X-Series base URL: https://{domain_prefix}.retail.lightspeed.app/api/2.0
LightspeedService is in mock mode when credentials missing
Frontend: Login with admin/admin works correctly
Frontend: Dashboard page loads after login with stats
Frontend: Sync Management page shows 'Manual Sync Triggers' and 'Sync Logs' sections
Frontend: Settings page shows 'Lightspeed Retail (X-Series) Connection' section
Frontend: Settings page has Domain Prefix input (data-testid='ls-store-id-input')
Frontend: Settings page has Personal Token input (data-testid='ls-secret-token-input')
Frontend: Helper text mentions 'retail.lightspeed.app'
Frontend: Test Connection button shows mock mode message
critical_code_review_comments: Server decomposition successful: 3300-line monolith split into 11 route modules under /backend/routes/
Route modules correctly use 'import deps' and 'deps.pool.acquire()' pattern (pool assigned at startup)
Lightspeed X-Series API v2.0 integration correctly implemented at https://{domain_prefix}.retail.lightspeed.app/api/2.0
Auth uses Bearer token in Authorization header
Settings correctly mask sensitive tokens (odoo_api_key, lightspeed_secret_token) as '***'
Sync progress tracker implemented with ProgressBar component and live polling (3s when running, 10s otherwise)
GET /api/sync/log/{log_id} endpoint returns single log with progress/total_items/processed_items fields
seed_data_creation: Fresh PostgreSQL database with only admin user (0 products, 0 suppliers)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Major refactor completed: server.py decomposed from 3300 lines to ~175 lines. Route modules in /backend/routes/: auth.py, suppliers.py, products.py, dashboard.py, settings.py, sync.py, odoo.py, lightspeed.py, categories.py, preprocessing.py, media.py. Database is PostgreSQL (not MongoDB). Lightspeed uses X-Series API at {domain_prefix}.retail.lightspeed.app/api/2.0. Sync progress tracker shows live progress bar for running jobs with 3s polling interval.

mocked_apis.Lightspeed Retail X-Series: MOCKED - LightspeedService returns mock_mode=true when credentials not configured. Real API calls would go to https://{domain_prefix}.retail.lightspeed.app/api/2.0
mocked_apis.Odoo ERP: MOCKED - odoo_service.py returns mock success responses

after.routes/preprocessing.py: Preprocessing products, validation, sync to Odoo

features: Shows progress percentage for running sync jobs
